desc:
🦿 Ride a MEGA MECH, jump into the canyon and CATCH rare pets!
💥 SLAM the ground, stun the pets around you and roll their rarity: Common… Mythic… SECRET!
🌈 Mutations: Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Galaxy and more. One in 25,000? Show your friends!
🐾 HOW TO PLAY
• Train at your gym to grow your Jump Power
• Jump farther = rarer pets (13 zones: Meadow to Outer Space!)
• Tap the pet you want, it hops onto your mech
• Put it in your pen and earn money every second, even offline
⚙️ UPGRADE
• 20 gym machines • 10 mechs with more luck and a bigger shockwave
• More pen space • Rebirth for x2, x3, x4… money and power
• Fill the Animal Index!
👍 Like the game and join group for updates!
